svg.title: Side quest — party vs. bugs
svg.desc: An auto-playing JRPG battle in a server-room dungeon. Three bugs block the road: NULLPTR, OFF-BY-1 and MEMLEAK. Watin the mage casts RAG, the knight runs unit tests and the dwarf throws a hotfix; each bug is defeated, then: Victory! The party gains 2026 EXP. Build passing.
